body:
Maya Chen: Quick sketch of a one
-page customer runloop for onboarding + renewal risk. Keeping it short.
Ravi Singh: Paste it. bullets only.
Maya Chen: Core flow: capture signal -> assign risk band -> quick mitigation -> schedule CSM touch -> log feedback.
Tess Morales: Call out owners per step (CSM / Eng-oncall / CS Ops).
Maya Chen: Owners added. Example signals -> actions:
- Signal: WAU drop >30% (7d) -> Band: RED -> Action: outreach + staggered prefill (T0, T+10m, T+30m).
- Signal: tokens per req down -> Band: AMBER -> Action: prompt review + sample replays.
- Signal: streaming timeouts >3% -> Band: RED -> Action: enable streaming-health webhook + temporary client rate cap.
Evan Clarke: Add copy/paste prefill for customers (lightweight):
```bash
while read id; do
 curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/prefill -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" -d '{"tenant":"'$id'","tokens":200}' &
 sleep 10
done < tenants.txt
wait
```
Ravi Singh: Batching advice: interactive 25-75ms window start batch 4-8; async 150-400ms start 16-64.
Maya Chen: Fallback rule: if P95 > SLO for 2 windows OR error spike -> swap to fallback model + page eng-oncall + tag CRM with "fallback-swap".
Tess Morales: CSM checklist (one-liners): confirm streaming vs REST; check last prefill; validate error graph; run sample interaction; agree next 72h owner.
Maya Chen: Telemetry fields to capture: time_to_first_dip, error_spike_count, streaming_pct, p95_latency_ms, last_prefill_ts, sentiment (green/yellow/red).
Evan Clarke: Security note for webhooks: require signed headers or whitelisted IPs.
CS Bot: Link: /internal-cs/prefill-guide and incident INC-2025-44 referenced.
Maya Chen: I'll format this into a one-pager and post to #playbooks. Volunteers to review?
Ravi Singh: I will review telemetry tomorrow.
Evan Clarke: I'll do a quick pass tonight.
Tess Morales: I'll check the CSM checklist.
